items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : SeminormedRing R] → Polynomial R → ℕ → ℝ
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ p $ over a seminormed ring $ R $, this function returns a sequence indexed by $ \mathbb{N} $ where each term is defined as $ \|p_n\|^{1/(d - n)} $ if $ n < d $, and $ 0 $ otherwise. Here, $ p_n $ denotes the coefficient of $ X^n $ in $ p $, $ d $ is the natural degree of $ p $, and $ \|\cdot\| $ is the seminorm on $ R $. This sequence captures the normed coefficients' growth rates relative to their distance from the polynomial's degree.

items.informal_description: A function that computes a degree bound for multivariate polynomials, taking a natural number $n$, a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, and an element of the sum type $\mathbb{N} \oplus \mathbb{N}$. This is used in the proof of Chevalley's theorem to establish well-founded recursion for multivariate polynomial constructions.

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞

items.name: MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] {w : σ → M} (n : M)
  (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) [inst_2 : DecidableEq M],
  (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n) φ =
    ∑ d ∈ φ.support with (Finsupp.weight w) d = n, (MvPolynomial.monomial d) (MvPolynomial.coeff d φ)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R} [inst_1 : Decidable (a = 0)],
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ((MvPowerSeries.monomial d) a) = if a = 0 then ⊤ else ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_eq_nat
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f = ↑n ↔
    (∃ d, (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 ∧ (Finsupp.weight w) d = n) ∧
      ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] {w : σ → M} (n : M)
  (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) [inst_2 : DecidableEq M] (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff d ((MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n) φ) =
    if (Finsupp.weight w) d = n then MvPolynomial.coeff d φ else 0

items.informal_name: Weighted order of a multivariate power series
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, the weighted order of $ f $ is the minimal natural number $ n $ such that there exists a monomial $ d $ with non-zero coefficient in $ f $ where the weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $ equals $ n $. If $ f $ is the zero series, the weighted order is $ \top $ (infinity).

items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if the coefficient of a monomial $ d $ in $ f $ is non-zero, then the weighted order of $ f $ is less than or equal to the weight of $ d $, i.e., $ \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(f) \leq \sum_{i \in \operatorname{support} d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $.

items.type:

{R : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_3} →

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree_withTop_some_comp
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_2 : OrderTop T]
  {D : A → T} {s : AddMonoidAlgebra R A},
  s.support.Nonempty → AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (WithTop.some ∘ D) s = ↑(AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D s)

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.le_inf_support_finset_prod
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} {ι : Type u_6} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T]
  [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T]
  {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → AddMonoidAlgebra R A), ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).support.inf degt ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, f i).support.inf degt

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.le_inf_support_list_prod
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : AddMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (l : List (AddMonoidAlgebra R A)), (List.map (fun f => f.support.inf degt) l).sum ≤ l.prod.support.inf degt

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.le_infDegree_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_2 : OrderTop T]
  [inst_3 : AddZeroClass A] [inst_4 : Add T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] (D : A →ₙ+ T)
  (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A),
  AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (⇑D) f + AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (⇑D) g ≤ AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (⇑D) (f * g)

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree_eq_of_max
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} [inst_3 : AddZeroClass A] {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} {b : B},
  b ∈ Set.range D → Function.invFun D b ∈ p.support → (∀ a ∈ p.support, D a ≤ b) → AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p = b

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.le_inf_support_pow
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : AddMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), n • f.support.inf degt ≤ (f ^ n).support.inf degt
